source.citation: Holland, T. J. B., Powell, R. (2011). An improved and extended internally consistent thermodynamic dataset for phases of petrological interest, involving a new equation of state for solids. Journal of Metamorphic Geology 29, 333-383.

transcription.from: the published article (PDF from the publisher), the Einstein temperature of an end-member on p. 346, read on the page
transcription.note: The empirical relation that gives each end-member i its Einstein temperature from its molar entropy S_i (J/(K mol)) and the number n_i of atoms in its formula: theta_i = 10636 / (S_i / n_i + 6.44). The temperature enters the thermal pressure of the modified Tait equation of state (Eqs. 11-13).

einstein_temperature_coefficient.description: The numerator of theta_i = 10636 / (S_i / n_i + 6.44), with S_i / n_i in J/(K mol).

einstein_temperature_entropy_offset.description: The constant added to the entropy per atom S_i / n_i in theta_i = 10636 / (S_i / n_i + 6.44).
